items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: a boy that called Robert played tramo in the band

ctx.x: Oh I was going to say, yeah that's right, Joe Lindsay told me once about that.

Joe Lindsay, well he was the voice band, Joe Lindsay was the drummer, T-Boy, the tramo player was Robert, a boy that called Robert played tramo in the band, and Louis Armstrong on the trumpet, Joe Welsh on the violin, and T-Boy on the guitar, the trumpet player, the guitar. Oh he played guitar player, he played guitar, and Louis Prevo played clarinet, he was a violin player, he was a good trumpet player in Detroit, because Louis Prevo, that's Louis Armstrong voice clarinet player. He'd go all around with his…
What's the last name spelled? Prevo?
